summary: SLOT2 first-slot composition cap enforcement and CONF1 confirmation exit live enablement. Two commits, four files, exact head 9ac9ca4. SLOT2 (7a726d4): adds a cw_resting_taken guard at the placement site inside _cw_v2_resting_track, blocking a second first-slot resting order after fill-then-flat-close within the same ATR segment. The suppression marker cw_resting_suppressed_segment_id defaults to 0 (UNEXERCISED), takes the fanout_segment_id when positive or -1 when zero, and dedupes the warning log per segment. The reclaim path in _cw_v2_reclaim_resting_track is completely separate and untouched. The new test test_LHAI_flat_close_cannot_place_second_first_slot_in_same_segment exercises the live resting manager end-to-end: it places, fills, closes flat, then asserts no second open intent and checks the log for the segment_id. Verified this test fails on the parent code (bcb4845) with 'a consumed first slot must not place another order' — the parent lets a second cw_entry_slot=first STOP_LIMIT through. The older test test_AN_EXITED_ENTRY_STILL_CONSUMES_ITS_SLOT at line 514 only inspects the state bit (cw_resting_taken remains True after exit) but never calls _cw_v2_resting_track again, so it passes even without the placement guard — that is the gap this PR closes. CONF1 (9ac9ca4): flips strategy_schwab_1m_v2_confirmation_exit_enabled default from False to True. Settings is a Pydantic BaseSettings cached via @lru_cache, stored once in SchwabV2BotService.__init__, with no hot-reload mechanism — activation requires a restart. Kill switch is override False plus restart, documented in the setting comment. The dark-mode test and unknown-atr-state test now explicitly construct Settings(confirmation_exit_enabled=False) instead of relying on the default, preserving their coverage. The fail-closed path is intact: _publish_confirmation_evaluation terminalizes the outbox row without publishing when the flag is False, and a later enable cannot release stale dark-period exits. The native OCO bracket path (_apply_v2_oco_bracket_entry in oms/service.py) is unmodified; brackets are armed at emit time before any confirmation bar can evaluate. Paper runtime is separate (PaperExitRuntime) and unaffected by the live flag. All 42 tests in the two touched test files pass. Full suite shows 526 failures and 2596 passes, identical to the parent commit (bcb4845). Zero new lint issues (34 pre-existing ruff warnings, same count on parent). No config, deployment, migration, or hidden runtime changes.
